eps.o: Jessel throws a Lunar New Year party to leave behind a year of loss but finds herself at odds with a friend. Sai opens up about her marriage. Hailey offers a glimpse into her unconventional life. Daisy shows a part of her world working for an icon.
Daisy throws a brunch for Sai that goes south when tensions resurface. Erin deals with a home emergency. Carole is offended by insensitive comments. Daisy reveals a sexy text exchange.

Daisy hosts a Seder for the group that ends up being a less than festive affair. Hailey divulges the trauma of her past. Erika takes a step towards growing her family. Erin and Jessel duke it out over coffee.

Daisy’s Passover Seder concludes with Erika’s invitation to her private island for a girls’ trip. Hailey and Erin cause a scene at Carole’s Gala. Jessel grows increasingly frustrated with Pavit’s career choice. Sai opens up to her aunt about her marriage.

The ladies escape New York for a luxurious getaway to Moskito Island, but paradise isn’t always perfect. Erin is shocked when Daisy reveals that Jessel and Erika gossiped about her flooded Hamptons house. Sai's marriage issues become public knowledge.
Still reeling from the news of her divorce filing, Sai grills Carole, which upsets Daisy. Jessel learns of a rumor from Sai, dragging her into the middle of Sai’s argument with Erin.

Erin tries to clear her name regarding accusations that she spread rumors about Jessel and Sai’s marriages. Carole confronts Sai for her invasive questions about the past. Hailey finds herself under a microscope.
Back from Moskito Island, Sai faces her new reality. Jessel fills Pavit in on the swirling rumors. At Erin’s Cuban Rumba party, one friendship hits a boiling point.
